introduction:
The Ration Card in Uttar Pradesh is issued by the Department of Food and Civil Supplies, Government of Uttar Pradesh. It ensures food security to eligible resident households by providing subsidised and free food grains (wheat, rice) through the extensive network of Fair Price Shops (Kotedar).

UP leverages the National Food Security Act (NFSA) and strongly encourages an Aadhaar-driven Public Distribution System (PDS). Ration cards in UP act as critical proof of residence, economic status, and help citizens avail benefits under multiple state and central schemes, including free ration distributions.
quickFacts:
Important Quick Facts
  • Purpose: Applying for a new Ration Card (Patra Grihasti or Antyodaya) in Uttar Pradesh.
  • State: Uttar Pradesh
  • Target Audience: Common Service Center (CSC) VLEs or e-District ID holders (Citizens cannot apply directly online; they must visit a CSC).
  • Head of Family Rule: The head of the family must be a female who is 18 years of age or older. A male can only be designated as the head if there is no adult female in the family.
  • Application Fee: ₹30 (deducted from the CSC operator's portal wallet).
  • Time Limit: An initiated application must be "Final Locked" within 72 hours, otherwise, it will be automatically cancelled by the system.
documentsRequired:
Documents Required for UP Ration Card

Note: Having a valid Income Certificate (Aay Praman Patra) issued in the name of the head of the family is critical (annual income less than ₹48,000 for the Antyodaya category).
Identity & Address Proof
  • Aadhaar Cards: Required for the head of the family and all family members to be added.
  • Bank Passbook: Belonging to the head of the family.
Files for Upload
  • Photograph: Passport-size photo of the head of the family (Format: JPEG, Size: Under 30 KB).
  • Scanned Documents: Bank Passbook and Aadhaar Card of the head of the family (Format: JPEG, Size: Under 100 KB).
Income Certificate
  • Income Certificate (Aay Praman Patra): Issued in the name of the head of the family (Income < ₹48,000 for Antyodaya).
Other Details
  • Gas connection details (if applicable).
  • Electricity connection details (if applicable).
onlineApplication:
Method 1: Online Application via e-District Portal (For CSC Operators / e-District Users)

Note: Citizens cannot apply directly online. This online application flow must be executed by a CSC operator or e-District ID holder on behalf of the citizen.
Step-by-Step Process:
  1. Step 1 (Login): Go to the e-District UP portal (edistrict.up.gov.in) and log in using the CSC/e-District User ID and password.
  2. Step 2 (Service Selection): From the dashboard, click on "Food and Civil Supplies (Ration Card)" which will redirect you to the FCS portal. Click on NFSA -> New Ration Card Application.
  3. Step 3 (Income Certificate Verification): Enter the Income Certificate Application Number and Certificate ID to proceed.
  4. Step 4 (Basic Details): Select your region (Rural/Urban), District, Block/Tehsil, Gram Panchayat, and the local Kotedar (Ration Dealer). Fill in the Head of the Family's details (Name in Hindi & English, Father/Husband's name, DOB, Gender, Category, Mobile Number, Occupation, and Annual Income). Enter Gas and Electricity connection details if available.
  5. Step 5 (Address Details): Enter the permanent and current residential address.
  6. Step 6 (Family Details): Click on "Add New Family Member" to add other members. You must provide their Name, DOB, Gender, Relation to the Head, and Aadhaar Number.
  7. Step 7 (Bank Details): Select the Bank Name, Branch Name, and enter the Account Number and IFSC code of the head of the family.
  8. Step 8 (Attachments): Upload the Head's Photo (under 30 KB), and the scanned copies of the Bank Passbook and Aadhaar Card (under 100 KB each).
  9. Step 9 (NFSA Criteria): You will be presented with a list of eligibility questions (e.g., Do you pay income tax? Do you own a four-wheeler?). Select "No" for these criteria to ensure eligibility.
  10. Step 10 (Draft Print & Final Lock): Save the application and print a draft copy. Verify all the details with the applicant. If correct, perform a "Final Lock" (must be done within 72 hours). The ₹30 fee will be deducted from the CSC wallet.
  11. Step 11 (Final Print): Generate and print the final Ration Card Application Receipt.
  12. Step 12 (Offline Physical Submission): Attach photocopies of all required documents to the final printout. Get it signed by the applicant and the Village Secretary/Pradhan, and submit the hard copy file to the Tehsil office (Supply Inspector) or the Food and Logistics Department.
offlineApplication:
Method 2: Assisted-Offline Route (For General Citizens)

Since the online portal is restricted to CSC operators, a normal citizen must follow this assisted-offline route:

Step-by-Step Process:
  1. Step 1 (Gather Documents): Gather all the required documents (Income Certificate, Aadhaar cards of all members, Bank passbook, and a photo of the female head).
  2. Step 2 (Visit Kiosk): Visit your nearest Common Service Center (CSC) or Jan Seva Kendra.
  3. Step 3 (Form Filling & Verification): Provide the documents to the operator, who will fill out the online form on your behalf and give you a draft print to check for spelling errors.
  4. Step 4 (Final Lock & Fee Payment): Once the operator locks the application and pays the portal fee, collect your final application receipt.
  5. Step 5 (Physical Submission): Take this final receipt, attach photocopies of all your documents, and physically submit the file to your local Tehsil/Block office (Supply Inspector) for verification.
afterApplying:
After Applying — Process & Verification

Field Verification

Once the hard copy is submitted at the Tehsil/Block office, the Supply Inspector will conduct a field verification to confirm your eligibility.

Digital Approval

Upon successful verification, the application will be digitally approved by the authorities.

Ration Activation

Your ration card will become active, and you can start drawing rations from your selected Kotedar.

Status Tracking

You can track your status or download the digital copy of the Ration Card from the official FCS website.
